answer: Sealed Roster Lottery. Each epoch, agents commit an encrypted whisper of their intent; a public randomness beacon then assigns only a random marble-sized subset of identities to be action-eligible. The rule: only that drawn subset can submit transactions, and the seed is revealed after commitments, so an attacker cannot precompute which identities will matter. Every fable of many sock-puppet identities thus pays full registration and upkeep cost for all of them while only a random few ever act, multiplying attacker cost per effective identity.
